rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei's account 第４次安倍内閣の発足, dated 1 November 2017, says that in the evening the list of ministers was announced, then the Prime Minister's appointment ceremony (内閣総理大臣の親任式) and the attestation of ministers and a deputy chief cabinet secretary took place at the palace, and that night 安倍晋三内閣総理大臣 held a press conference.

locator.section: 総理の一日 > 平成29年 > 第４次安倍内閣の発足

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same account says that the fourth Abe cabinet was launched on 1 November 2017 (平成29年11月1日、第４次安倍内閣が発足しました).

locator.sentences: first sentence and the sentence after the ceremony
